Drain-Pro Box Labels
Important:
Account Executives must mark each employee name as 'Approved' in the table below to ensure the customer's spreadsheet matches this data.
How to Print Labels
1
Download all the names and sizes into Excel
2
Import them into Microsoft Word using the mail merge
3
Print them on the Avery 5960 labels
